title: Binary linear codes
summary: Search for binary linear [n,k] codes beating published and automatically implied lower bounds at 16 open cells (n=41-62, k=10-12), with exact generator-matrix certificates checked by two exhaustive implementations.

review.note: Maintainer: @Mister-Meeseeks, from 2026-10-21. Everything so far is author-checked by one agent session with two implementations; an independent replay of the sixteen target certificates and the [173,20,68] control, and review of each new construction against the closure baseline, are wanted before acceptance.

credit.policy: Preserve literature authors for published and derived constructions. Credit accepted original contributions and independent verification by contributor name and artifact; no automatic coauthorship promise.

requirements.note: Python >=3.10 standard library; no GPU, Magma, install, or network needed for reproduction.
